style.description: The visual style and base primitive library used when generating components (e.g. "base-vega" = Base UI primitives with the Vega style).

tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS configuration used when generating and styling components.

config.description: Path to the Tailwind config file, relative to the project root. Leave empty for Tailwind v4 projects, which configure Tailwind in CSS instead of a JS/TS config file.

css.description: Path to the global CSS file where Tailwind directives and CSS variables are defined, relative to the project root.

baseColor.description: The base color palette used to generate the default theme's CSS variables (e.g. "slate", "zinc", "neutral").

cssVariables.description: Whether to theme components using CSS variables (true) or static Tailwind utility classes (false).

prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to all generated Tailwind utility classes, useful for avoiding collisions with existing styles.

rsc.description: Whether the project supports React Server Components. When true, generated components that need interactivity include a "use client" directive.

tsx.description: Whether to generate components as TypeScript (.tsx) files. When false, components are generated as plain JavaScript (.jsx).

iconLibrary.description: The icon library used by generated components (e.g. "lucide", "tabler", "radix").

aliases.description: Import path aliases used when generating and importing components, matching the paths configured in tsconfig.json/jsconfig.json.

utils.description: Import alias for shared utility functions (e.g. the "cn" class-name helper).

components.description: Import alias for the components directory.

ui.description: Import alias for the directory where UI primitives (button, dialog, etc.) are installed.

lib.description: Import alias for the shared library/helpers directory.

hooks.description: Import alias for the custom React hooks directory.

menuColor.description: Color treatment for menu-like surfaces (dropdown menu, context menu, command menu, etc.).

menuAccent.description: Accent style used to highlight selected/active items within menu-like components.

rtl.description: Whether generated components should support right-to-left text direction.

registries.description: Custom component registries, keyed by an "@"-prefixed namespace (e.g. "@acme"), used with `shadcn add @acme/button`.

oneOf.description: A URL template for this registry containing a "{name}" placeholder for the requested item.
A registry definition with a URL template plus optional query params and request headers (e.g. for auth tokens).

url.description: A URL template for this registry containing a "{name}" placeholder for the requested item.

params.description: Additional query string parameters to send with each request to this registry.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with each request to this registry (e.g. "Authorization").
